headline: Bodyworks regulation and a nursing and communicable diseases update.
summary: Nicholas Antanavica, Commissioner of the Inspectional Services Department, will present on Bodyworks regulation. Amelia Houghton, Chief PHN, and Dr. Jennifer Bradford, HHS Medical Director, will give a nursing and communicable diseases update.
